name: GUTPUNCH: Underground Reflex Circuit
description: GUTPUNCH is a stripped-down, brutally effective underground BCI combat reflex game that strips away all visual polish to deliver raw kinetic feedback — players experience simulated strikes, throws, and joint locks as genuine neural pain signals at 40% real-world intensity, far above the legal 8% threshold. Distributed as a 14-megabyte mod patch on encrypted the Gray Zone mesh networks, it requires no hardware beyond a standard BCI and a secondhand haptic rig, making it accessible to anyone in the Gray Zone with the nerve tolerance to play it. Matches last an average of four minutes and leave winners with a documented adrenaline-cortisol spike equivalent to a real street fight.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 medic begins treating GUTPUNCH-related neural injuries in a the Gray Zone clinic and gets drawn into the community's internal politics when a champion goes missing before a major bout.
Someone has released a new GUTPUNCH variant with pain thresholds at 90% — and people are still downloading it.
A corporate esports scout is secretly attending underground GUTPUNCH bouts looking for recruits with reflex profiles that don't show up in legal league data.
